title: Diwali at the Outer Sunset Farmers Market & Mercantile
description: Celebrate Our 4th Annual Diwali (the Festival of Lights) at the Outer Sunset Farmers Market & Mercantile!
long_description:
Celebrate Our 4th Annual Diwali (the Festival of Lights) at the Outer Sunset Farmers Market & Mercantile!

About this Event

Join us again for a FREE celebration of tradition and enlightenment with our fourth annual Diwali Festival at the Outer Sunset Farmers Market & Mercantile. Featuring live music, chutney and sari demos by Shanta Sacharoff, henna by Hennapub, diya candle decorating 🪔 + rangoli sand art at Artship, pop-up South Asian vendors, and more! Did we mention free chai? 🫖 Yep, that too!
PLUS, our raffle is back with $100s in gift certificates and prizes from small neighborhood businesses like Arizmendi Bakery, Henry's House of Coffee, Judahlicious, and more! 🎁 Check out our pinned Instagram post (@outersunsetfarmersmarket) for info on how to buy tickets! There will be MANY chances to win something!

The Outer Sunset Farmers Market & Mercantile is every Sunday from 9am to 2pm, rain (or fog) or shine, at 37th Ave & Pacheco St in San Francisco. Find fresh produce, hot food, all-ages arts & crafts at Artship, and seasonal programming!
Instagram: @outersunsetfarmersmarket
